title: lane r3 SE: one-defect-per-commit unsatisfiable for shared-root-cause findings
description: Lane round 3. Lens: SE (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: two filed findings are two defects by linkage-definition, but a single-root-cause fix is atomic — neither symptom greens without the shared change; no merge or split rule exists. Citations verified: contract:81, :83. Proposed: resolved-candidate (consolidation is the legal path: shared-root-cause findings consolidate before the fix — one absorbs the others with cross-reference closure, the survivor lists all symptoms and names all pin tests; one owning finding per fix commit, gate runs all its pins).
